violation_type.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - on Sides (26 TAC §747.4607(c))
violation_type.short_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - on Sides
violation_type.typical_finding: One outdoor swing did not have the required amount of use zone space around it.  The provider removed the swing during the inspection and brought this into compliance.

finding_variants.text: One outdoor swing did not have the required amount of use zone space around it.  The provider removed the swing during the inspection and brought this into compliance.
A raised tree stump was observed within the use zone of a swing structure
At the time of inspection that swing set in the backyard of the home did not measure 6 feet in front of the to and fro swings and was close to the patio's brick wall.
